whatsapp.title: WhatsApp notifications
whatsapp.scope: Receive published results, exam grades, fee reminders and campus fraud alerts on WhatsApp.
whatsapp.withdrawal: Consent is optional. Uncheck and save to stop future sends. Changing your profile number requires new consent.
whatsapp.agree: I agree to receive these notifications on this number.
whatsapp.phoneHelp: Use the same international number as your profile, starting with +.
whatsapp.error: Unable to load or save consent. Please try again.
whatsapp.usage: WhatsApp · {month}: {used} / {limit} submissions reserved; {remaining} remaining. Failed or uncertain submissions also count.

reasons.WHATSAPP_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Explicit consent for this number is required.
reasons.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE: No approved template is configured for this language.
reasons.WHATSAPP_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The monthly WhatsApp limit has been reached.
reasons.WHATSAPP_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN: Submission outcome is uncertain; no automatic resend.
reasons.WHATSAPP_SUBMISSION_FAILED: Provider submission failed; no automatic resend.
reasons.WHATSAPP_NOT_CONFIGURED: WhatsApp is not configured for this deployment.
reasons.WHATSAPP_PHONE_REQUIRED: No valid international phone number is available.
